The public Skill supports sync/task management, not Savault Q&A MCP. Built-in Ask Your Collections is an Obsidian feature. Windows is pinned to unified 0.1.6; Mac retains CLI 0.1.0.

Windows unified 0.1.6: https://github.com/lin113311221/savault-skills/releases/tag/desktop-v0.1.6
Local folder guide: https://github.com/lin113311221/savault-skills/blob/main/docs/local-folder.md
Windows GUI+CLI supports local Markdown / Notion / Obsidian. Mac remains on older packages. No Savault Q&A MCP.
